field.name: apportionment_formula
field.comment: REQUIRED: Set to three_factor, single_sales, or double_weighted_sales

field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: Economic nexus gross receipts threshold - NY uses $1M threshold

field.name: state_additions
field.comment: State-specific additions: federal interest, IRC 199A addback, bonus depreciation, etc.

field.name: state_credits
field.comment: State tax credits: R&D, jobs, film, renewable energy, etc.

field.name: state_subtractions
field.comment: State-specific subtractions: municipal interest, state taxes, state NOL, etc.

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: NY corporate income tax rate - 6.5% per Tax Law § 209

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: Economic nexus transaction count threshold - Default 200 (update if state differs)

field.name: ny_in_mta_region
field.comment: Business located in MTA region (NYC metro area)

field.name: ny_mta_surcharge_rate
field.comment: NY MTA surcharge rate (0.34% for businesses in MTA region)
